description: Expressive English TTS. Clones the speaker's reference clip, or uses its built-in voice when there is none. An exaggeration control sets how dramatic the delivery is. MIT license.
cpuNote: Works on the CPU, but slowly.

settings.label: Exaggeration
settings.description: How expressive the delivery is. 0.5 is neutral; higher is more dramatic (and tends to speed up).

settings.label: CFG weight
settings.description: How closely it follows the reference voice. Lower it (about 0.3) with high exaggeration for a calmer pace.
